notes: Eclipse Loop 2.5.8 - recording prints again. An arranger take was being captured correctly and then thrown away when you pressed stop, so you could hear yourself while armed and no clip ever appeared. This release also withdraws 2.5.7's microphone change, which could leave Loop with no audio input at all until you restarted it. If you updated to 2.5.7 and lost your input, this is the fix.
